newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bavaria PM Stoiber welcomes bank merger plan.
newsitem.headline: Bavaria PM Stoiber welcomes bank merger plan.

text.p: Edmund Stoiber, prime minister of Bavaria, on Monday welcomed plans for the German state's two largest listed banks to merge.

Stoiber said in a statement that the decision by Bayerische Vereinsbank and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechselbank to merge meant Bavaria's banks would be stronger in both national and international competition.
He said the Bavarian government was working on the assumption that the merger would take place with the utmost consideration for the banks' employees.
Banking sources have said they expect 5,000 to 7,000 jobs to be cut at the two banks over the next five years.
